title: Barrier log-concavity for forests
statement: For every finite forest $F$, let $\alpha(F)$ be its independence number and write its independence polynomial as $I(F;x)=\sum_{k=0}^{\alpha(F)} i_k x^k$, where $i_k$ is the number of independent vertex sets of size $k$. Then, for every integer $k$ with $1\le k<\alpha(F)$, if $i_{k+1}>i_k$, one has $i_k^2>i_{k-1}i_{k+1}$; equivalently, the independence sequence of every finite forest is barrier log-concave.
references: - [Barrier Log-Concavity of Large Forests](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22098) — arXiv — Vadim E. Levit

progress.label: Open · progress reported
progress.tldr: A new paper claims the conjectured inequality for all sufficiently large forests, but the statement for every finite forest remains open.
progress.summary:
The problem asks whether barrier log-concavity holds for every finite forest. The latest result establishes a uniform sufficiently-large regime and strict consequences for several tree and forest classes, but does not settle the finite case.

*[arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22098)*

**Known results**

- Levit and Mandrescu (2004) conjectured log-concavity of independence polynomials for all forests.
- Computations verified ordinary log-concavity for trees with at most $25$ vertices.
- Kadrawi, Levit, Yosef, and Mizrachi (2023) exhibited non-log-concave trees on $26$ vertices; Kadrawi and Levit constructed infinite counterexample families.
- Galvin showed that log-concavity can fail arbitrarily far from the end of the sequence.

*[arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/html/2610.07943) · [arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/html/2305.01784)*

**October 2026 asymptotic result**

Vadim E. Levit's preprint *Barrier Log-Concavity of Large Forests* claims barrier log-concavity uniformly for sufficiently large forests, yielding strict log-concavity for several tree and forest classes. This is substantial asymptotic progress, but it does not prove the assertion for every finite forest and is unverified here.

*[arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22098)*

Current status (as of October 2026): barrier log-concavity is claimed for a uniform sufficiently-large regime, while the assertion for every finite forest remains open.

*Caveats. The asymptotic result is reported from a preprint and has not been independently verified.*
